scientific_question: Among character-qualified codistributed insect lineages, does greater mutual geographic co-opportunity predict greater excess reuse of post-IBD spatial genetic structure?

identity_opening.edge_genetic_distance: mean p-distance across all cross-locality sequence pairs with >=50% jointly canonical columns on each unchanged frozen edge
identity_opening.failed_edge_after_opening: hard invariant failure; no species dropping, backfill, graph repair, marker switching, or threshold relaxation

response_operator.source_response: endpoint-safe post-IBD residual turnover followed by frozen length orthogonalization
response_operator.source_to_target_skill: Spearman correlation between 500-km single-source Gaussian field prediction and target post-IBD turnover

primary_inference.reference_distributions: exact four survivor private-reference beta_G arrays from the qualified synthetic run
primary_inference.primary_p_value: maximum component p-value across A in {0.5,1,2,3}

forbidden: change the 500-km G definition or threshold G after opening
drop species or dyads after opening based on empirical genetic response
select taxonomic or geographic subgroups after opening
change nuisance controls, center weights, private amplitudes, or reference distributions after opening
rerun the one-shot opening under alternate genetic distance, kernel, IBD, or p-value definitions
reinterpret a calibrated null as evidence that geography is unimportant
